claims.claim: BotPsy lifts BFCL v4 from 23.4 to 44.0, ACEBench from 30.1 to 58.7, and τ-bench from 23.2 to 51.5.
claims.episode_span: It achieves state-of-the-art tool-use results for its size, lifting BFCL v4 from 23.4 to 44.0, ACEBench from 30.1 to 58.7, and τ-bench from 23.2 to 51.5.
claims.source_title: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
claims.supporting_quote: BotPsy roughly doubles the agentic capability of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Think on key benchmarks: BFCL v4 rises from 23.4 to 44.0, ACEBench from 30.1 to 58.7, and τ-bench from 23.2 to 51.5

claims.claim: TimeOmni-o1 was trained on the MMTR dataset of 500k+ multimodal samples across 12 domains.
claims.episode_span: It was trained on the new MMTR dataset of 500k+ multimodal samples across 12 domains and outperforms both standalone LLMs and time-series models on understanding and forecasting tasks.
claims.source_title: TimeOmni-o1: Bidirectionally Coupling Time Series Foundation Models and LLMs for Multimodal Reasoning and Forecasting
claims.supporting_quote: To train it, we build MMTR, a multimodal time series reasoning dataset with annotated reasoning traces, covering both tasks across 12 domains with 500k+ samples.

claims.claim: The byte-level conversion of the 27B model was trained for 178.6 hours on 8xH200.
claims.episode_span: The conversion shrinks the vocabulary to 384 entries and continues training on 4.77 GB of self-generated dialogue and encyclopedia data for 178.6 hours on 8xH200.
claims.source_title: One Byte, One Token: Byteifying a 27B Hybrid-Attention LLM with Self-Generated Data

claims.claim: Synapse-Control replaces 4,987 generative diagnosis calls and reduces auxiliary control time by 50.2% and 51.0% on AppWorld and WebShop.
claims.episode_span: Across 1,308 attempts on AppWorld and WebShop it achieves 29.8% more successes than the base agent while replacing 4,987 generative diagnosis calls and halving auxiliary control time.
claims.source_title: Synapse-Control: Making Agent Experience Actionable with Lightweight Runtime Control
claims.supporting_quote: replaces 4,987 generative diagnosis calls, and reduces auxiliary control time relative to Sentry by 50.2% and 51.0%, respectively.

claims.claim: OpticalRAG improves a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbone by 5.17 points on LongBench-v2 while injecting only 16 tokens.
claims.episode_span: On LongBench-v2, BAMBOO, and LooGLE-v2 it records the best compression-aware accuracy while adding only 16 tokens and lifting a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbone by 5.17 points on LongBench-v2.
claims.source_title: OpticalRAG: Pixel-Space Compression for Token-Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation
claims.supporting_quote: improves the closed-book Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbone by 5.17 points on LongBench-v2.
